chunks.text:
[The Hour Arrives]
{a deep bell toll and a low string swell, the pendulum bass beginning to swing in 3/4}
positive_styles: 3/4 waltz time like a great clock
low pendulum bass swinging root and fifth every bar
deep tolling tower bell on the hour
soft clock-tick percussion: woodblock and tom on the downbeat
awed mysterious legendary encounter, vast and ancient, solemn but tense

chunks.text:
[First Strophe]
{the patient minor melody rises in a lifting leap then settles stepwise, over the swinging pendulum bass and clock-tick percussion; the phrase hangs unresolved on the minor fifth chord}

chunks.text:
[Second Strophe]
{the melody again an octave higher with strings fuller and a bell marking every second bar; the cadence falls deceptively to the sixth chord}

[The Turning Wheel]
{contrast: the music turns to F major and C major, the melody broader and more urgent, timpani rolls and a rising string line, the great wheel straining to turn}

{the patient minor melody returns in full; it finally reaches the major dominant chord with a strong leading tone, and the last bar leads straight back into the first strophe, no ending}
